description: This file defines the 'Command' class, a wrapper around an AMQP 1.0 message representing a device command in the Eclipse Hono client. It includes methods for creating commands, validation, accessing message properties, encoding/decoding reply-to address options, and handling command identifiers.
published: complete set of public static and instance methods including: from, getCommandMessage, isOneWay, isValid, getInvalidCommandReason, getName, getTenant, getDeviceId, isTargetedAtGateway, getOriginalDeviceId, getRequestId, getPayload, getPayloadSize, getContentType, getReplyToId, getReplyToEndpoint, getCorrelationId, getApplicationProperties, getDeviceFacingReplyToId, encodeReplyToOptions, isReplyToContainedDeviceIdOptionSet, isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a device command encapsulating an AMQP message with helper methods for validation, property extraction, and command ID management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Command instance from an AMQP Message, tenant ID, and device ID, validating required fields and adapting the reply-to address.

methods.name: getCommandMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP message representing the command.

methods.name: isOneWay
methods.description: Determines if the command is one-way (no response expected).

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the command has all required valid properties.

methods.name: getInvalidCommandReason
methods.description: If invalid, provides reasons why the command is invalid.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the command's subject (name).

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID targeted by the command.

methods.name: isTargetedAtGateway
methods.description: Checks if the command is targeted at a gateway device.

methods.name: getOriginalDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the original device ID from the command message, considering redirection.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID used for correlating responses.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the message payload.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the message payload.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to ID as used in the message.

methods.name: getReplyToEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the reply-to endpoint name.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID of the message.

methods.name: getApplicationProperties
methods.description: Returns the application properties of the message.

methods.name: getDeviceFacingReplyToId
methods.description: Constructs the reply-to ID from an original reply-to ID, device ID, and endpoint usage.

methods.name: encodeReplyToOptions
methods.description: Encodes reply-to options (device ID contained, legacy endpoint used) into a single string.

methods.name: isReplyToContainedDeviceIdOptionSet
methods.description: Checks if the reply-to address originally contained the device ID based on the encoded flags.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if the command was directed at the legacy (control) endpoint based on the encoded flags.
